extra.final_summary:
Found and fixed data quality issues:
1. Species column had 4 label variants (case differences and "Gentto" misspelling) - normalized to allowed labels (Adelie, Chinstrap, Gentoo)
2. Two rows (row 2 and row 50) had negative flipper_length_mm values (-190 and -195) which violate the valid range [170, 235] per rules - excluded these rows
3. body_mass_g was stored as text with some values like "3,900" - converted to numeric

After fixes, calculated average flipper length by species:
- Adelie: 193.17 mm
- Chinstrap: 196.92 mm  
- Gentoo: 216.68 mm

Analysis based on 49 valid rows (2 excluded due to invalid flipper lengths).
